case.title: Wrong/no session
case.variant: A separate manually opened private tab has a recovery intent flag but no usable recovery link material or isolated recovery session
case.context: Leave the genuine recovery/password-form tab open. Manually open a separate new tab in the private window and paste only the public target above; do not duplicate, refresh or replace the genuine recovery tab.
case.expected_message: This link or session is unavailable. Open the newest email or request another link.
case.cleanup: After reporting this separate tab's result it can be closed; retain the original verified password-form tab for later controlled steps.

source_review.auth-security.js: createLinkController.verify explicitly rejects missing link material before falling back to any Auth session. A recovery intent flag alone grants no reset permission.
source_review.auth-flows.js: The password form stays hidden until controller.verify succeeds. A link_unavailable error maps to the expected safe message.
source_review.session-entry.js: Constructing the callback entry does not itself require verification, send mail or adopt an application session.
existing_scoped_local_cases: a recovery flag without link material never loads an existing session
real page module rejects a flag-only recovery without showing a password form

later_password_save_readiness: Actual password save/continuation remains separate and requires controlled gateway-code recipient and bounded application-window readiness; do not trigger it in this negative test.
